item.title: Danantara BUMN Karya Deadline, Indonesia Solar Surge, OpenAI Security Pivot
item.description: Indonesia's sovereign investment arm sets a hard year-end deadline on its most distressed construction SOEs while Jakarta's 2027 electricity subsidy bill climbs 18% — together they define the fiscal pressure shaping every energy and corporate decision this week.
